basic_info.description:
This inviting 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom home in the vibrant Sunset neighborhood offers both charm and potential. While move-in ready, it provides the perfect opportunity to update and customize to your hearts desire.

The kitchen and dining room are bathed in natural light, thanks to abundant windows and a charming skylight, creating a warm and welcoming atmosphere. The ground floor features a versatile bonus bedroom and a cozy family room, ideal for guests, work, or play.

With 1,500 sq. ft. of living space on a spacious 2,996 sq. ft. lot, the home offers a practical layout and endless possibilities to reimagine its classic style. Whether you refresh its timeless charm or add modern finishes, this home is ready for your personal touch.

Dont miss your chance to bring your vision to life in this naturally bright Sunset gem. Schedule your showing today!
